verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a standalone command-line program that reads stdin and writes stdout. The docs say it can run through GitHub Actions (with an official example repo) and ship a pandoc/latex container image. It can also be compiled as a self-contained binary or run in HTTP server mode, and a community user reports scripted pipelines producing Word reports automatically. missing for 10: documentation of CI-specific behavior such as exit codes and non-interactive error handling, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage specifically (the community evidence covers general scripting).
